high: STALE_OLD_MECHANIC_CONTENT: Although hotel-trip.place.image was removed, the trip-hotel profession entry still references T("school-trip-hotel"). This is the same old-mechanic asset that the approved specification prohibits because it depicts room-grid placement and bath scheduling. The repair evidence's claim that the asset is not referenced anywhere is false, and the image can remain child-visible through the profession/job-reveal content.
medium: QA_REGRESSIONS_OVERCLAIM_COVERAGE: The harness only rejects school-trip-hotel within 400 characters after the hotel-trip experience ID, so it misses the remaining trip-hotel profession image reference and incorrectly passes its stale-image check. Additionally, only one combined assertion actually detects the stale-closure implementation; the separate add-only check would not have caught the reported v1 closure bug.

failure_codes.finding: The prohibited old-mechanic school-trip-hotel asset remains referenced by the trip-hotel profession entry, contradicting the approved no-image decision and the repair evidence's claim that it is no longer referenced anywhere.

The stale-image regression regex is scoped only to the hotel-trip experience and therefore passes despite the same prohibited asset remaining in the trip-hotel profession entry. The claimed two batching-bug checks also overstate coverage: only the combined prev[id] assertion would catch the v1 closure read.
